events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Wendy had a deal and Wendy had promised to work as Monica Geller's waitress.
Rachel Green asks who Wendy is.
Monica Geller says Wendy bailed on working as Monica Geller's waitress.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller currently has no waitress.
Rachel Green says Wendy bailing is too bad.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green wishes she could work as Monica Geller's waitress.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has made plans to walk around.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green knows that Monica Geller supported Rachel Green after Rachel Green ran out of Rachel Green's wedding.
Monica Geller says Rachel Green ran out of Rachel Green's wedding.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller was there for Rachel Green when Rachel Green ran out of Rachel Green's wedding.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller put a roof over Rachel Green's head by letting Rachel Green live with Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller's help means nothing to Rachel Green.
